examples.name: Default
examples.summary: An overview's usage strip: four StatTiles in one card, split by dividers, each delta aligned to the end of its cell. One cell per row in a narrow box, two from the group's medium size, all four in a row on a wide one.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import StatTile from '@aziontech/webkit/stat-tile'
  import StatTileGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/stat-tile-group'
</script>

<template>
  <StatTileGroup aria-label="Usage">
    <StatTile
      label="Data transferred"
      :value="842"
      unit="GB"
      :delta="12.4"
    />
    <StatTile
      label="Requests / second"
      :value="1240"
      unit="/s"
      :delta="3.8"
    />
    <StatTile
      label="Bandwidth saving"
      :value="588"
      unit="GB"
      :delta="6.2"
    />
    <StatTile
      label="Data offload"
      :value="70"
      unit="%"
      :delta="-1.5"
      inverse
    />
  </StatTileGroup>
</template>

examples.name: BesideCard
examples.summary: A dashboard row: the usage strip beside a taller card. The row stretches the group to the card's height and the cells share it, so no empty band sits under the tiles.
